meta.name: Yudh
meta.description:
Principled but hard-driving businessman Yudhisthir Sikarwar works to expand his empire whilst keeping an explosive secret.

Ended · First aired 14 Jul 2014 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Endemol Shine India · Network: Sony Entertainment Television

Complete series. On your server: S1 20/20

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Yudh's Battle
videos.overview: Business tycoon Yudh, owner of Shanti Constructions informs Commissioner about the flyover which was constructed years back and also alerts him. Yudh's Brother-in-law Ranjan releases from jail after serving 11 years of imprisonment. Yudh focuses on his next project of mining and Health Science Institute and also shares his views with Minister. Secret of Dharmendra Malik's flyover gets leaked in the Media. Yudh gets to know a shocking truth about Municipal General Hospital where her Daughter Taruni is working. Is Yudh hiding a secret?

videos.title: Yudh Admitted to the Hospital
videos.overview: An unknown Person gives a shocking footage to Mona in which a group of People are trying to demolish the structure. Yudh calls for an urgent Press Conference and shows the footage to media. Yudh is urgently admitted to the Hospital. Who are involved in demolishing the Municipal General Hospital? Does Yudh's Family know his secret?

videos.title: Yudh Wins the Bid
videos.overview: Yudh wins the bid for coal mining despite the Commissioner's machinations. However, his reputation receives a further blow when the CD proving him innocent is rumored to be fake. At the same time, his newly set up mining operation receives Naxalite threats. Yudh finds his secret benefactor, but he proves to be unhelpful. Will Yudh be able to prove his innocence and protect his reputation?

videos.title: Mamta Malik Gets Murdered
videos.overview: Nikhil is shocked as Yudh reveals his secret affair with Mamta. Anuj fumes in anger as Mamta Malik gets murdered. Yudh insults News Head Mukesh Chhabaria as he blames Yudh for Mamta Malik's murder. Anand comes up with an interesting plan to persuade News Head Mukesh Chhabaria. Will Mukesh get convinced? What will be Mukesh's next move?

videos.title: Taruni Finds Out Yudh's Secret
videos.overview: Taruni is shocked to know about Yudh's illness. Yudh feels uneasy and faints. Dr. Mehra who was on his way to Yudh's office meets with an accident. Meanwhile, Taruni rushes for Yudh's rescue but this apparently does not go down too well with Nayantara. Yudh's file gets stolen. Who killed Dr. Mehra? Who is keeping an eye on Yudh's movements?

videos.title: Dr. Mehra's Son Gets Caught
videos.overview: Dr. Mehra's Son gives a statement to Police and Media which apparently does not go down too well with Yudh and he asks Anand to keep a watch on Dr. Mehra's Son. Taruni insists Yudh to urgently call a Press Conference and reveal the secret about his illness.

videos.title: Yudh's Son Rishi Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Yudh appoints Taruni as the new CEO of Shanti Constructions but this apparently does not go down too well with Nayan. Mona reveals a shocking truth to Anand. Dharmendra Malik gives final warning to Yudh. Yudh's Son Rishi who was managing Mining work gets kidnapped. Who kidnapped Rishi?

videos.title: Bomb Blast in Mining Area
videos.overview: Naxalites demand Rs. 20 cores for releasing Yudh's Son Rishi from the Jungle. Yudh firmly decides to agree to their demands and also plays a brilliant game. Rishi somehow manages to escape from the jungle with the help of Kids. A blast occurs in Mining area. Will Yudh land in deep trouble?

videos.title: Yudh's Workers Go on Strike
videos.overview: Taruni insists Yudh not to drag her in his Business world as she is happy serving people as a Doctor in a Hospital. Yudh rushes to mining area as he gets to know about strike and also promises his workers to do best for them and their Families. What will be Taruni's final decision? Will Minister agree?

videos.title: Minister's Final Warning
videos.overview: Mona rushes to rescue Smriti who lands in deep trouble. Minister gives final warning to Yudh. Worker's Village is set on fire and Taruni rushes to save the Girl who was half burnt. Yudh is once again attacked by the same Clown. Will Taruni succeed in saving the Girl? Who set the Village on fire?

videos.title: Kapil Gets Arrested
videos.overview: Mona files a missing complaint of Smrity and Kapil gets arrested. Kapil gives Mona's laptop which had secret documents to Dharmendra Malik. Rishi returns to work and requests his Father Yudh to give him one chance to prove his potential. Taruni and Rishi are supporting Yudh. Will Yudh come to know about Mona's problem?

videos.title: Anand Gets Arrested
videos.overview: One of the informers reporting to Devraj meets Rishi and requests him to return back to Mumbai. Mona is shocked as she comes to know that Dharmendra Malik's Lawyer is helping Kapil. Anand gets arrested. How will Mona find out the truth?

videos.title: Deal Between Rishi and Home Minister
videos.overview: Rishi meets Home Minister to supply more electricity to the mining area. Anand gets caught by Police in the Agent's House. Anand lands in deep trouble as Police finds a Shirt and broken teeth in his Car. Yudh is once again attacked by the same Clown. Massive fight takes place between Yudh and Clown. Will Home Minister agree?

videos.title: Yudh's Wife Nayan Gets Shot
videos.overview: A shocking incident occurs with Nayan in the mining area. Nayan gets shot and is urgently admitted to the Hospital. Nayan's condition is critical and Yudh convinces Taruni to operate Nayan. Ranjan gets angry with his team who were supposed to kidnap Rishi.

videos.title: Taruni Operates Yudh's Wife Nayan
videos.overview: Despite of having no knowledge in surgery, Taruni takes a huge risk of operating Yudh's Wife Nayan. Nayan's condition is critical. Rishi fumes in anger and also meets Home Minister to find out the truth behind the shooting incident. What will happen when Rishi and Yudh will come to know that Nayan's Brother Ranjan is involved in the planning? Will Taruni's surgery prove to be a successful one?

videos.title: Yudh's Final Decision on Mining Business
videos.overview: Yudh gets angry with Rishi as one of the Villagers gives a shocking statement in media about Rishi. Mona is shocked to know that the Housekeeper that she was looking for is killed and also insists her to tell Anand to surrender to Police.

videos.title: Argument Between Anand and Yudh
videos.overview: Anand's Wife reveals to him that he has always ignored his Family and has given more importance to Yudh and his Family. Massive argument takes place between Yudh and Anand as Yudh decides to appoint Rishi as the CEO of Shanti Constructions. Anand joins hands with Yudh's enemies. Will Yudh land in deep trouble?

videos.title: Dharmendra Malik Gets Murdered
videos.overview: Dharmendra Malik and Nikhil get to know about Anand's fall out and also tries to convince him to enter in his troop to destroy Yudh and Shanti Constructions. Anand agrees but only on one condition that he would like to meet his 3rd Partner. Anand is shocked to meet their 3rd Partner. Who killed Dharmendra Malik?

videos.title: Taruni Gets Kidnapped
videos.overview: Anand reveals a shocking truth to Yudh about Aju. The nurse, working for Anand ties up his wife and hands over a machine gun to his son who is mentally disturbed. The boy plays around with the gun, he isn't aware of the consequences of his actions. Taruni gets kidnapped. Will Yudh succeed in releasing his Daughter Taruni?

videos.title: Yudh's Fight Of Life and Death With Ajju
videos.overview: Anand gets severely injured while saving his Son Aditya. Ajju kidnaps Taruni and also calls Rishi and Yudh. Ajju gives a deadly task to Rishi and on the other side, massive fight of life and death takes place between Yudh and Ajju. Will Yudh succeed in saving his Daughter Taruni?
